messages.author: df5a0c65c0a6e123
messages.subject: Can't Display Coverage Layer
parts:
Hello,

I'm using Distance 5 and I'm trying to create a Coverage Layer. I'm trying
to create this layer under the global layer but when I click on Coverage
when selecting the layer type, I keep getting the message "The following
internal error has occured in Distance - Record '1' not found"

Anyone know why this is happening and what I can do to create the coverage
layer?

Thanks!!!!


Scott Crosbie

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: Can't Display Coverage Layer
parts:
Hi Scott,

Try double-checking that your global layer is a valid polygon (e.g., that it
displays in a map okay - I wish I could reccommend a comprehensive shapef file
checking utility - perhaps others can?), and that you have your units correct,
so that at least one grid point is being generated (of course typically one
wants thousands). If you still can't get it to work then send me a copy of
your project (as a zip archive) and I'll check it out.

Cheers,

- Len
